scope: Pinned-source architecture, canonical data ownership, integration, security, safety and operability synthesis for required artifact 10. This is static source evidence only.
architecture_rule: One operating organisation across multiple Sites; Site access, exact action permissions, ownership, consent and privacy are the boundaries. Legacy tenant-labelled fields are not evidence of tenant isolation.

provisional_claims.title: Legacy staff-store lifecycle divergence is conditional on an external or live writer that is not established
provisional_claims.claim: HrEmployeeProfile is the canonical inspected source path and StaffController labels staff as a read-only compatibility fallback. Retain the divergence question only if a live or external writer still mutates staff; otherwise retire it.
provisional_claims.required_gate: Identify every deployed writer to the legacy staff store and reconcile representative records before any finding promotion.

provisional_claims.title: Service-agreement status history and current status are written without one transaction or lock
provisional_claims.claim: History creation and agreement status mutation are separate unlocked statements; failure or concurrency could leave them inconsistent. No induced-failure or concurrency witness exists.
provisional_claims.required_gate: Execute bounded failure and concurrent-transition cases on a disposable database and reconcile current status with history.

provisional_claims.title: Incident review direct-object path lacks an established canonical Site-access check
provisional_claims.claim: The review route binds ClientIncident; the policy requires incidents.approve and submitted status, and review locks and reauthorizes through that policy without an explicit canonical Site-access assertion.
provisional_claims.required_gate: Execute an allowed same-Site review and a concealed foreign-Site direct-ID denial with a Site-restricted approver.

provisional_claims.title: A given controlled-drug administration can record a register entry without a truthful stock balance
provisional_claims.claim: Only for controlled_drug with given status: stock is optional and on_hand nullable integer; the service can write null balances when stock is absent, floor insufficient stock to zero, and accept fractional quantity against integer balance columns.
provisional_claims.required_gate: On disposable MySQL, execute absent-stock, null-stock, insufficient-stock and fractional-dose cases and reconcile register and stock balances.

provisional_claims.title: Consent notifications can perform external side effects before the enclosing database transaction commits
provisional_claims.claim: Consent flows synchronously send mail plus database notifications inside database transactions; the inspected notifications do not implement ShouldQueue. External delivery cannot be rolled back if a later database or channel operation fails.
provisional_claims.required_gate: Use fake and failure-injected channels to prove commit, rollback and exactly-once delivery behavior without sending real notifications.

provisional_claims.title: Legacy calendar-sync trigger reports success and advances last_synced_at while dispatch is commented out
provisional_claims.claim: This claim is limited to the inspected Operations CalendarSyncController surface and does not claim that Sites Calendar CalendarSyncService is universally nonfunctional.
provisional_claims.required_gate: Bind the live route to its deployed owner and verify provider-side effects plus truthful status under success and failure.

provisional_claims.title: Authentication event subscriber is not registered while event discovery is disabled
provisional_claims.claim: AuthEventSubscriber defines handlers, but the registered EventServiceProvider neither lists it nor enables discovery; exact-class source search found only the subscriber definition.
provisional_claims.required_gate: Boot the pinned application in an authorised disposable environment and prove login, logout, failed-login and reset event persistence.

provisional_claims.title: Site rent posting can finish normally after per-Site failures and present a partial batch as successful
provisional_claims.claim: PostSiteRentJob catches per-Site exceptions, logs them and returns normally. Payroll persists an error and rethrows; depreciation aggregates failures and throws. tenant_id is legacy organisational context, not a tenant-isolation boundary.
provisional_claims.required_gate: Induce one per-Site failure in a disposable batch and prove job status, retry, alert and ledger reconciliation behavior.

provisional_claims.title: Hourly task escalation has an O(users x providers) source shape with unmeasured production impact
provisional_claims.claim: The command iterates every approved user and invokes per-user provider aggregation. Source establishes the shape, not an SLA breach.
provisional_claims.required_gate: Measure representative and upper-bound user/provider/task cardinalities, query counts, memory and wall time in an authorised disposable environment.

not_established: Any live or external writer still mutating legacy staff, and actual staff/profile drift.
Deployed MySQL migration and constraint state matching the pinned migration source.
Production entity, user, provider, work-item and queue cardinalities.
Foreign-Site direct-ID incident review behavior with a Site-restricted approver.
Controlled-drug absent-stock, null-stock, insufficient-stock and fractional-dose behavior on MySQL.
Consent mail or channel failure after external delivery but before transaction commit.
Live calendar provider connectivity and actual synchronization after the inspected trigger.
Authentication-event handler invocation and persisted login-log behavior.
Scheduler, worker, webhook and finance operational health, retries, dead-letter handling and partial-batch alerting.

official_source_boundary.use: Source facts, audit inference and specialist decisions remain separated. The baseline may frame later review but proves no application mapping or compliance outcome.

attestation: Independent source reconstruction followed by root normalization. No application files, runtime, browser, tests, build, database, external provider, legal, clinical or VCS state were changed.
